notes: Hunger bar shows normal drumsticks again (it was feathers)
Ping Wheel: the ping key now defaults to the middle mouse button on new installs
Older instances are now told to download this new one when they try to join
Essential added: custom skins, outfits and capes now show for everyone who has it
Ping Wheel: hold the ping key (middle-click by default) to ping a spot for your friends
Vein Miner: mining an ore with a pickaxe now breaks the whole vein, no key needed
Fresh Animations player and horse animations added
Your Photon look is now the default: darker nights and better colours
Running particles removed; villager and player snoring halved; fewer glowing particles on dropped items
Timber: chopping a log fells the whole tree (sneak to take just one log), no axe needed in hand
@claude answers now show in public chat
The raw 'fastback.broadcast.message' text from the backup mod no longer shows in chat
The instance name now shows the pack version

Essential is kept on version 1.5.0.1: 1.5.1 turns the inventory character pink. If you launched v3 before this note and see it, close the game, delete the file .minecraft/essential/Essential (fabric_26.3).jar (plus its .meta and version.json) and launch again
Hearts, hunger and the hotbar show again (they fade to dim instead of hiding for good)
Unique Dark hotbar instead of the Immersive Interfaces one
New rainbow bolt icon for the instance and the server
Fixed the error spam on every launch (removed the Remove Reloading Screen mod)
MakeUp Ultra Fast shader added on Windows for lower-end PCs
First release
